paite: Tura kho puakgik. Tarshish longpite aw, mau tuaituai un; innte om lou khop leh lutna ding om lou khop a hihsiat in a-omta hi; huai lah Kittim gam a kipan in akiang uah hihlat in a-om hi.
heading: Phoinisiate Thu
english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

paite: Tuikulh a omte aw, dai sipsip un; Sidon kho sumsin tuipi a paite'n ahon kiningchinsak uh.
english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.

paite: Shihor a pan buhchi tuipite tung ah hon pua a, Nile lui a buh, apunna hi a, namte sumsinna mun ahi hi.
english: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

paite: Sidon aw, zum in; tuipi kulhpi in thu agenta ngal a, "Nau ka vei ngei kei a, ka nei ngei sam kei, tangval lah ka vak ngei sam kei a, nungak leng ka khangliansak ngei sam kei hi,” chi in.
english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

paite: Thuthang Aigupta gam atun hun chiang in Tura thuthang anak vei mahmah ding uhi.
english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

paite: Tarshish ah va hoh unla; Tuikulh a omte aw, mau tuaituai un.
english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

paite: Hiai maw na kho kipak uh, upat a upa, akhe in gamlapi a om ding a api sek?
english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

paite: Lallukhu khusaktu khua Tura tung ah kua'n ahia hiai tung ding a sep? Huai lai a sumsin mite lah miliante ahi ua, huai lai a sumsin mite lah lei a mizahtakhuaite ahi uhi.
english: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, thupina tengteng kisaktheihna nawngkaisak ding leh lei a mizahtakhuai tengteng muhsithuai a omsak ding in asep hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

paite: Tarshish tanu aw, Nile lui bang in na gam ah luanglet in; na kawnggakna himhim lah a-omta kei hi.
english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

paite: Tuipi tung ah akhut azak a, gamte alingsak a; TOUPA'N Kanaan gam tungtang ah thu apia a, akulhte hihse ding in.
english: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

paite: Ama'n, "Sidon tanu nungak aw, mi nuaisiah, nuam na sa nawn kei ding; thou inla, Kittim gam ah galkah in; huai ah leng khawlna himhim na mu tuan kei ding hi," achi hi.
english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

paite: En in, Kaldaite gam; hiai mite a-omta kei uh; Assuria mi in gamdai a gamsate a ding in asepta hi; a-insangte uh alam ua, huai a inpite ahihmang ua, inn sia in abawlta.
english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

paite: Tarshish longpite aw, mau tuaituai un; na kulhte uh hihsiat in a-omta hi.
english: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Tura khua, kumpipa khat kum sim a, kum sawmsagih sung mangngilh in a-om ding; kum sawmsagih abei nung in kizuak la a agen bang un Tura kho tung ah ahong tung ding.
english: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

paite: Nang kizuak mite mangngilhsa nung, kaihging la inla, kho kim ah vak in, kaihging kai inla, theih a na om nawn theihna ding in la tampi sa in.
english: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

paite: Huan kum sawmsagih abei nung in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N Tura apha ding a, huchi in huai minu aloh delh in a-om nawn ding a, leitung a khovel lalgam tengteng lak ah kizuak in a-om ding.
english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

paite: Asum muhkhiak leh aloh TOUPA a ding in siangthou ahi ding; huai lah kholkhawm in hiam, koihkhawm in hiam a-om kei ding a, asum muhkhiak TOUPA ma a omte a ding in ahi ding a, niang-le-tai a anek ding uleh, puansilh thupitak aneihtheihna ding uh ahi.
english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
